_README.purpose: CANONICAL record of owner-decoded enemy mechanics. Created 2026-08-10 after the Frantic Escape mechanic had to be re-told THREE times across context compactions. Grep HERE before modeling an enemy, filing an owner question, or claiming a mechanic is unknown. Mirror of relic_notes.json for enemies. Append-only in spirit: refine entries, never drop owner facts.
_README.conventions: mechanic = owner decode (near-verbatim, dated). modeled = where the code implements it. gaps = known approximations / open questions.
_README.harvest_trap: bestiary.json 'statuses' include PLAYER-INFLICTED effects (our potions/cards land as statuses on the enemy): Demise = our Powdered Demise potion, Shackling Potion, Mangle, Weak/Vulnerable etc. Never read a bestiary status as an innate fight feature without checking it isn't ours (owner 2026-08-10).
_README.card_text_trap: Live card descriptions carry RUN-SPECIFIC riders appended to base text: enchants (Swift 'Draw N cards the first time this is played', Replay N, Slither...) AND fight effects (owner 2026-08-10: an 'Ethereal.' rider, possibly from the Three Knights fight in Act 3). Never record a single sighting as canonical text -- build_card_effects.py majority-votes per run for this reason. Same family as harvest_trap above.

The Insatiable.mechanic: Sandpit ('In 4 turns, you will be eaten and die.') is applied AFTER turn 1, so base expiry ~turn 5. It also seeds the deck with 6 unique Frantic Escape status cards: playing one increases the timer by 1, and each play increases its own energy cost by 1, starting from 1 (owner 2026-08-10; third telling -- earlier tellings were encoded only in capability.py's closed-form pad). Demise on this boss in harvests = our Powdered Demise potion, NOT innate.
The Insatiable.modeled: capability._SANDPIT_TIMER_PAD (=4: +1 late application, +~3 affordable escapes) pads the deadline in BOTH estimate_fight and the rollout (rollout raced the raw 4 until 2026-08-10 -> 0% forecasts while run 20260809-230646 won live).
The Insatiable.gaps: Escapes are a flat pad, not simulated plays (their escalating energy isn't debited); optimal escape timing is a multiturn-planner problem.

Waterfall Giant.mechanic: 0 HP -> does NOT die or explode instantly: becomes an untargetable 'preparing' shell whose HP displays as infinity (actually 2^32-1), does nothing that turn. Next player turn its intent = Steam Eruption sized by the stacks accumulated all fight (+3 per most of its moves), delivered as a NORMAL BLOCKABLE attack on ITS turn, then it dies. If it reaches 0 on ITS OWN turn (e.g. poison), the preparing phase is its NEXT turn -- one beat later (owner 2026-08-09). STATUS TEXT (2026-09-30, visible from round 2): STEAM_ERUPTION_POWER N = 'When killed, deals N damage at the end of your next turn' -- +3 per move (15 r2 -> 30 r7), so the blast's size is known all fight.
Waterfall Giant.modeled: rollout erupting-shell physics c494a72 (kill -> quiet tick -> blockable strike -> death + win check); one-turn planner prices the live eruption via the DeathBlow intent (type filter fix 2026-06-26); bestiary sentinel HP clamped in bestiary_enemy + harvest guard (a9e0449 -- the 2^32-1 display was recorded as max HP and made WG forecasts unkillable). Kill-turn budget (2026-09-30, era tally: 13 of 14 WG deaths on the promoted keys were eruption deaths after kills taken at 2-29 HP vs 30-42 blasts): EnemySim.eruption; a dead erupting body is NOT fight-over; the pending blast minus eruption_expected_block (8) is charged as loss on the kill turn (death wall if it kills you); while it lives, HP below (next stack - 8) pays the scarcity rate as a budget term -- the race blocks mid-fight instead of racing to 15 HP.
Waterfall Giant.gaps: Poison-timing variant (one-beat shift) not distinguished in the rollout; knockdown card-resolution FREEZE during this phase is the batch-killer hang subclass (PLAN, fork asks). eruption_expected_block is a flat 8, not the deck's block/turn; kill-deferral vs a growing stack is the multiturn planner's call.

Queen.mechanic: Guarded summoner: while any Torch Head Amalgam minion lives she does not attack -- she Buffs (her awakened dps grows per turn) and re-blocks ~20 self-block. The last minion's death 'wakes' her at the buffed dps; she never resummons. Torch-first is usually right and fast (owner A/B 2026-08-02, both target orders taped). Torch swings ~24.8 realized dps. Demise/Weak/Vulnerable in her harvest = player-inflicted. HUMAN BASELINE (owner 2026-08-13): the Queen is the boss humans beat MOST FREQUENTLY when encountered -- above even act-1/2 bosses -- so bot losses here are BOT-DIAGNOSTIC, not difficulty.
Queen.modeled: capability.FightEnemy guarded_by_minions/awakened_dps/awakened_buff_per_turn; standard._BOSS_SUMMONS + _BOSS_GUARDED wire the 2-body forecast; rollout guarded/awakened physics. LIVE-PLANNER FIX 2026-08-11 (4642772): Torch's MINION status made it 'ignorable' (Kin flee rule) so the planner Queen-focused and lost f48 run 20260810-235031; _GUARDED_LEADER_NAMES + SimState.guard_active now disable the minion discount while she's guarded -- A/B on the live state flipped the opener to Torch-first.
Queen.gaps: Forensics 2026-08-13 (15 full-stack fights): 4 died in-guard, rest died 1-3 rounds post-break (two near-wins: Queen at 9 and 2 hp). guard_break remapped race->focus (small blocks re-valued vs the ~25/turn Torch rent; setup keeps normal economics). Next levers: guard-phase setup emphasis + awakened-race kill-ETA via the oracle; Torch dps prior 36 vs taped 24.8 still unfixed.

Lagavulin Matriarch.mechanic: Sleeper: damage dealt while asleep COUNTS (she keeps it), but hitting her wakes her. Waking deliberately is correct when holding a real burst; poking her awake with chip is the sin. Waking is not always wrong (owner). The fight fundamentally punishes one-turn reasoning -- benchmark boss for the multiturn planner. WIKI+CORPUS VERIFIED 2026-08-11: sleep = 3 free turns MAX (or unblocked damage); 12 Plating decays 1/turn asleep and is LOST on wake; post-wake 4-cycle Slash 19 / Disembowel 9x2 / Slash2 12+12Block / Soul Siphon. No phases.
Lagavulin Matriarch.modeled: combat sleeper v3: waking hit pays w_wake_sleeper (-16); sleeping rampers exempt from ramp_damage credit, ramp-stall penalty, and focus-race bias; pokes hold, bursts wake. Rider-pokes deliberately unpinned (owner: judgment call). v4 (2026-09-28, A0 era: 18/20 fights woke her by card, 9/11 losses were round-1/2 pokes): wake = HP LOSS only (a hit her Plating block soaks stays asleep, pays nothing); w_wake_sleeper is per forfeited free turn (stacks-1: 3->2, 2->1, 1->free); a paid wake turn earns no focus/ramp premium on her (its raw damage IS the burst weighed against the setup turns).
Lagavulin Matriarch.gaps: Turn-2+ deliberate stall lines need the multiturn planner (spec filed). Wake bar (-16/turn) is the owner's flat sizing; whether round-1 bursts of ~25 should still clear a 2-turn forfeit is unreviewed.

Axebot.mechanic: Stock: when killed while Stock is active, a replacement Axebot is summoned. The replacement NEVER attacks -- it only buffs -- so assume no additional incoming damage post-'lethal'; lethal shouldn't be over-feared while Stock is active (owner 2026-08-08).
Axebot.modeled: combat spawns_on_death (from 'when killed...summoned' text) kills the false fight-over read; buff-only note in code comment.
Axebot.gaps: Replacement's buff effect on other enemies unmodeled.

Thieving Hopper.mechanic: Flutter: 'Receives 50% less damage from Attacks.' Unparsed, it produced false lethals (audit find 2026-08-06).
Thieving Hopper.modeled: capability._ATK_REDUCTION_RE -> attack_dmg_taken_mult; combat EnemySim + rollout atk_mult.

Bygone Effigy.mechanic: Slow: the displayed amount is CUMULATIVE-so-far; per-play stacking must be seeded from the turn's play count, not the display (audit find, fixed via turn_plays counter).
Bygone Effigy.modeled: standard turn_plays counter -> plan_combat_turn plays_this_turn -> slow_stacks seed (display ignored).
Bygone Effigy.gaps: Pre-fix audit corpus still echoes the old over-prediction; expected to drain.

Kaiser Crab.mechanic: Surround: bonus dps when flanking bodies survive (Crusher/Rocket +5 each, empirical). Owner A/B 2026-08-03: the winning line vs the two-claw phase is a feasibility calc on killing Rocket before its turn-4 Laser, not a block rule -- multiturn spec #1. CORPUS FACT (verified 2026-08-11 after a wrong collision claim): 'Rocket'/'Crusher' names are UNIQUE to this fight -- 241/241 instances at act 2 floor 33, always the two-claw opening cohort. Kaiser is ALWAYS the floor-33 act-2 boss encounter in our corpus. WIKI+CORPUS VERIFIED 2026-08-11: both claws run FIXED 5-cycles; Rocket's Laser 31 recurs T4/T9/T14 (Recharge does nothing on T5); Crab Rage: surviving claw gains +6 Str AND 99 Block when its ally dies -- the post-kill turn is quasi-invulnerable, factor into kill sequencing. No separate Kaiser phase.
Kaiser Crab.modeled: capability._EMPIRICAL_MOVES surround_bonus_dps; rollout surround_bonus in strike.
Kaiser Crab.gaps: Kill-by-Laser-turn feasibility = multiturn planner test case.

Soul Fysh.mechanic: Player DoT ~4/turn average + 1 str ramp (empirical rows; Underdocks mid-frequency elite).

Lagavulin (classic).mechanic: Soul Siphon: -2 Str AND -2 Dex per cast, every 4th round post-wake, permanent. A move/intent, not a status (live-traced 2026-07-09).
Lagavulin (classic).modeled: capability drains_player/drain_every; rollout drains tick; closed-form drained accumulator.

Knowledge Demon.mechanic: WIKI+CORPUS VERIFIED 2026-08-13 (284 fights): 379 HP, 4-cycle -- Curse of Knowledge (forced card pick) / Slap 17 / Knowledge Overwhelming 8x3 / Ponder (11 dmg + HEALS HIMSELF 30 + gains 2 Str). After the 3rd Curse the cycle drops to 3 moves. The heal+ramp makes it a HARD RACE: each cycle adds 30 effective HP, +2 Str incoming, and another Disintegration tier (6/7/8, 21 total by cycle 3). Owner pick table: Disintegration always right (vs Mind Rot / Sloth / Waste Away) -- and the picks arrive as fully-labeled card_selects (the old 'textless options' finding is stale; _DEBUFF_PREFERENCE drives the choice). Hardest boss for humans per the tracker, tied w/ Aeonglass.
Knowledge Demon.modeled: Move script wiki-verified w/ cycle=4; _DEBUFF_PREFERENCE picks Disintegration; Disintegration self_end_damage seeded from live status; closed-form 'Ponder' heal + _EMPIRICAL_MOVES regeneration row. Mode row: race (now grounded).
Knowledge Demon.gaps: Post-T9 3-move cycle approximated as 4; oracle kill-ETA vs the 30/cycle heal clock is the natural defend/race refinement.

Knight Trio (Three Knights).mechanic: Owner 2026-08-10 (hedged 'possibly'): a fight effect in the Act-3 Three Knights encounter adds an Ethereal. rider to cards in hand/deck for the fight -- seen contaminating harvested card texts (Stone Armor+, Bully+, Infernal Blade, Mad Science).
Knight Trio (Three Knights).modeled: Not modeled in-fight; harvest-side majority vote keeps it out of the canonical catalog.
Knight Trio (Three Knights).gaps: Confirm the source fight and exact scope (hand? drawn? all?). LETHALITY question RESOLVED (owner 2026-08-10): it is legitimately Ethereal -- the majority vote was right to keep it.

Aeonglass.mechanic: OWNER FULL DECODE 2026-08-28 (supersedes 2026-08-13 corpus read): 512 HP, Artifact 3 (hurts vulnerable-burst setup directly). WITHERING PRESENCE: adds a Wither to HAND each time you play 6 CARDS (a per-cards-played counter -- punishes card-spam; Stampede/Hellraiser extra plays feed it). Wither: unplayable status, end of turn if in hand deal 3 + X*3 damage (tier X = upgrade level; the old flat-6 note was the post-first-upgrade tier -- explains the +3.7 audit residue). INCREASING INTENSITY every 3rd turn from T3, X = casts so far: (1) shuffles Wither+X into DISCARD (2 at A9+), (2) gains 2+X Str (3+X at A9+), (3) upgrades ALL Withers to +X, (4) Withering Presence now adds Wither+X. Direct damage AND wither damage scale QUADRATICALLY -> kill speed matters, but so does card-play EFFICIENCY; exhausting statuses (True Grit+/Stoke) becomes very important. Owner: 'fundamentally a difficult boss'; suspects the bot shows up trying to vulnerable-burst (overrepresented archetype at her door) into Artifact 3.
Aeonglass.modeled: Move script cycle=3 wiki-verified; Withers priced via the stranded-status hand class; Artifact strip credit (w_artifact_strip); _BOSS_DRAFT_RULES AEONGLASS exhaust_tool_bonus 2.0; mode row race (grounded 2026-08-13).
Aeonglass.gaps: Ebb-turn targeting nuance unexploited (attacking into 33 block vs debuffing that turn); audit residue +3.7 under-predicted n=7 -- likely Wither tier variants; watch.
Aeonglass.owner_steer_2026_08_23: Aeonglass is the HARDEST boss -- kills the most human runs too. 'Setup is essential' -- direct contradiction of the pure-race mode row. But the owner is 'not entirely sure what the issue is without seeing some of the decks and fights and trying them out' -> diagnosis path: (1) decision-digest slice of the 10 Aeonglass-loss decks from batch bjyle284k-era, (2) Aeonglass snapshot via watch_boss_checkpoint for owner hands-on + bot A/B (setup_burst row candidate). Do NOT change the mode row without that evidence.
Aeonglass.owner_steer_2026_08_28: Dossier review: hard to tell whether any deck SHOULD have won -- except deck #1 (4 Offerings + Stoke for cleanup) which the owner thinks should have. Hypothesis to check: planner does not understand (a) Wither damage output/scaling, (b) the every-6-cards-played Wither-to-hand trigger.

Test Subject.mechanic: WIKI-VERIFIED 2026-08-15 (slaythespire.wiki.gg) on top of the owner decode: 3 staged bodies via Adaptable ('when it would be defeated, it instead revives even stronger'). P1 100hp (A8 111): Enrage 2 (A9 3, +Str per SKILL played) -- alternates Bite 20 (A9 22) / Skull Bash 14 +1 Vuln (A9 16). P2 200hp (A8 212): Painful Stabs (Wounds shuffled into discard per UNBLOCKED hit) -- Multi-Claw 10x3 every turn, +1 hit per use (A9 11). P3 300hp (A8 313): Nemesis -- 'at the end of every OTHER turn, gains Intangible 1' (boss takes max 1 dmg the following turn); move cycle 3: Lacerate 10x3 (A9 11x3) / Big Pounce 45 / Burning Growl (3 Burn + 2 Str; A9 5 Burn + 3 Str). CRITICAL: ALL status effects clear on phase transition (incl. its own Enrage Str) -- debuffs invested just before a phase kill are WASTED. Structural refinement of the owner decode: intangible period is 2, move cycle is 3 (LCM 6) -- intangible does NOT always coincide with the big-output turn; owner's alternation read is the intangible rhythm, the damage rhythm rides the 3-cycle.
Test Subject.modeled: Stage bodies via _BOSS_STAGES (Phrog dormant-wave machinery). Harvest was fragmented by the specimen-number flavor suffix ('Test Subject #C137') -- fixed 2026-08-15 (canonical_enemy_name in forward.py + harvester). Phase-3 alternation NOT yet modeled: needs a burst_window mode flavor (gate ATTACK spend on non-intangible turns, dump block/setup into intangible turns) -- inverse of defend_deadline (gates defense); plus a phase-kill debuff-waste guard (statuses clear on revive). Mode-table entry pending owner review. 2026-10-02: Painful Stabs (P2) MODELED -- combat._score charges w_painful_wound (-3.5) per unblocked hit (block soaks whole hits in order; nothing on a phase-kill turn). Trigger: A1 tapes 2026-10-01 -- the bot raced 12x4/13x5 P2 turns at 0 block (76->41 HP + 4 Wounds) and entered P3 short.
Test Subject.gaps: P1 Enrage skill-tax term unmodeled (P2 Painful Stabs modeled 2026-10-02); exact parity of Nemesis start turn (first intangible on T2-end vs T1-end) unverified -- read it off the live status on next encounter.

Ceremonial Beast.mechanic: WIKI-VERIFIED 2026-08-18 (slaythespire.wiki.gg): 252hp (A8 262). P1: Plow attack 18 (A9 20) +2 Str per use (ramps every turn). Plow POWER: first time hp <= 150 (A9 160) -> STUNNED one turn + loses ALL Strength (one-time threshold; free turn for us). P2 (post-stun) cycle 3: Beast Cry (applies Ringing 1 -- play only 1 card that turn) / Stomp 15 (A9 17) / Crush 17 (A9 19) +3 Str (A9 4) PERMANENT. Both phases ramp.
Ceremonial Beast.modeled: Threshold stun: DFS attack-to-threshold (combat.py stun_threshold/stunned_this_turn) + capability.py Str-reset on stun. Ringing: card_cap. Mode row: race (both phases ramp), graduated from TBD 2026-08-18 -- table now fully wiki-verified.
Ceremonial Beast.gaps: None known at the mechanics level; losses here are deck-power/ramp-race losses, not modeling gaps. If f17 deaths persist, look at act-1 draft quality, not the fight model.

Decimillipede.mechanic: Act-2 elite of 3 segments (40-46 HP each). Reattach (bestiary status text): 'If other segments are still alive, revives in 2 turns with 25 HP.' Killing one segment at a time is a treadmill -- arm v3 run 4 (2026-09-03) killed the same segment repeatedly for 12 rounds from a 74/80 entry and died; it was 3 of the calibration arm's first 7 elite deaths and 4/51 era deaths.
Decimillipede.modeled: combat.py EnemySim.reattach (REATTACH id / 'revives in ... segment' text) + SimState.reattach_kills; _score cancels w_kill and charges w_reattach_futile_kill for segment kills that leave any segment alive at plan end, so the one-turn planner lowers all segments into range and kills them together. _fight_plan returns None for Reattach boards (no sweep kill bonus). AoE potions are held for it in act-2 normals (owner 2026-07-29).
Decimillipede.gaps: The 2-turn revive window isn't planned across turns (a kill-all over two turns would also work); revive HP 25 hard-coded in the description, not the model.

Mecha Knight.mechanic: Act-3 elite, 300 HP, Artifact 2, Strength 5 (bestiary). Intent cadence identical across 8 tapes (2026-09-03): a 3-round cycle -- round 1 BIG attack 25; round 2 small attack 4; round 3 two non-attack intents (it gains 15 Block for the next round); round 4 BIG 40-42; round 5 small 4; round 6 setup; round 7 BIG 45-46; round 8 small 4 ... i.e. BIG on rounds 1, 4, 7, 10 escalating roughly 25 -> 40 -> 45 -> (~50?), a 4 poke on 2, 5, 8 and a free setup round on 3, 6, 9 with 15 Block up on the following BIG round.
Mecha Knight.modeled: Not yet. The one-turn planner sees each round's intent but has no cross-turn block plan: era 3/14 and arm 3/7 deaths (29%), typically dying to the round-7 BIG with no block in hand after spending block cards on the poke rounds. Candidate: move-script the cycle (data/move_scripts.json) so the forecast/potion lanes and a block-hoard lane see the next BIG; damage plan = race 300 HP in ~9 rounds needs ~35 dmg/round.
Mecha Knight.gaps: The 4th big hit's size unobserved (no fight reached round 10 alive); whether the block is exactly 15 every cycle (one tape shows 7/14).

Entomancer.mechanic: Personal Hive (status text, decoded from logs 2026-09-30): 'Whenever this enemy is hit by an Attack, add 1 Dazed into your Draw Pile' -- per HIT, so multi-hit cards (Whirlwind, Uppercut, Byrd Swoop, Pummel) flood the deck; Empower raises the Hive stack (1->2->3 seen) and Strength. Move cycle seen: NxK multi-hit (2x7..7x7), big single (13..20), Empower. Act-2 elite, 145 HP. Era (A0 promoted keys): 135 fights, 3 deaths, survivor loss mean 12 / p75 21, but 10 blowouts >=40 (7%) -- the Dazed flood in long fights (run 20260930-001237: 80 -> 7 HP from full, hand of 4 Dazed by round 6, then a 7x5 unblocked).
Entomancer.modeled: combat: EnemySim.hive (Personal Hive stacks); each hit landed on it pays w_hive_dazed x stacks (deck pollution; exempt on the killing turn) -- fast single-hit kills preferred, multi-hit cards discouraged as the stack grows (2026-09-30).
Entomancer.gaps: Dazed already in the draw pile is not tracked as a shrinking-hand horizon; whether flat block per hit (7 small hits) is priced well vs the big single hit is the multiturn planner's call.

Exoskeleton.mechanic: Hard to Kill: 'Reduce all damage taken and HP lost by Exoskeleton to 9' -- a PER-INSTANCE cap (live 2026-09-30: one body lost 27 in a single player turn), so multi-hit cards punch through and big single hits are wasted past 9. Act-2 pack of four 24-28 HP bodies that Buff (Strength) between 8/10/12 hits and 1x3/3x3/5x3 multi-hits; a ramping grind that punishes slow decks. Era (A0 promoted keys): n=122, mean loss 10.6, p75 15, 7% blowouts -- but 2 deaths in batch 5's first 7 runs on 52-53 HP entries.
Exoskeleton.modeled: capability.detect_mechanics: 'reduce all damage taken and HP lost to N' -> dmg_cap_per_hit (was folded into the per-turn cap built for Hardened Shell, so the one-turn planner and the rollout wrote off every follow-up hit into a body that had taken 9); combat per-hit loop and rollout _hit cap each instance (2026-09-30). Intangible (Soul Fysh) moved to the same per-instance key.
Exoskeleton.gaps: capability.estimate_fight's kill-time math only knows the per-turn cap; a per-hit cap is uncapped there (acceptable: it over-estimates damage into Exoskeletons slightly).

Infested Prism.mechanic: Vital Spark N (status text, decoded from logs 2026-09-30): 'ALL Skills are Tainted N' -- every Skill in hand reads 'Gain N Tainted when played', and the player status Tainted is 'Take N additional damage from Attacks this turn' PER HIT. Stack grows with its Empower (2 -> 4 seen). Move cycle seen: 15 / 11+Defend / 5x3 / 8+Buff+Defend. Act-2 elite, 161 HP, the most frequent act-2 elite in the corpus (143 era fights, mean loss 14.6, p75 24). Batch-6 tape (run 074854 f25): two Skills then a 5x3 landed for 31.
Infested Prism.modeled: combat: SimState.tainted from TAINTED_POWER; PlannedCard.tainted_gain from 'Gain N Tainted'; _score incoming += tainted x hits per attacking enemy (2026-09-30). A Defend into a 5x3 turn now reads as a net loss; attacks and potions are untaxed.
Infested Prism.gaps: Tainted stacks reset each turn (modeled as this-turn only); whether Skills should be held for the single-hit turns is the multiturn planner's call.

Globe Head.mechanic: Galvanic N (status text, decoded 2026-09-30): 'Powers are afflicted with Galvanized' -- every Power in hand carries the KEYWORD Galvanized = 'Take N damage when this card is played' (N=6 seen). Act-3 hallway body, 139 HP; cycle seen 13+Debuff / 6x3 / 16+Buff. Era (A0 promoted keys): 30 fights, 1 death, mean loss 14.9, p75 21, ~1.5 galvanized Power plays per fight (~9 HP/fight of unpriced self-damage).
Globe Head.modeled: combat._to_planned scans card.keywords for 'Take N damage when this card is played' and adds N to fx.self_hp_cost after the per-turn-power zeroing (2026-09-30) -- Powers now pay the hit; the suicide veto covers a fatal one.
Globe Head.gaps: Modeled as unblockable HP loss; if the game lets Block absorb it the cost is slightly over-stated. Any other keyword-borne rider is still invisible to the parser (it reads descriptions only) -- worth a keyword sweep of the card catalog.

Bowlbug pack.mechanic: Act-2 hallway pack of 2-3 bowlbugs (logs 2026-09-30). Rock (45-48 HP): 15 every turn; IMBALANCED 'If its attacks are fully blocked, it becomes Stunned' (its Stun intent shows 144 of 437 logged ticks). Nectar (36 HP): 3 / Buff (+15 Strength, seen as STRENGTH 15) / then 18 -- kill it before the buff or eat 18s. Silk (40 HP): Debuff (Weak/Frail) / 4x2. Egg (21 HP): 7 / Defend. Often paired with a Slumbering Beetle (85 HP, Slumber). Batch-6 blowouts 42-56 and two deaths in batches 7-8 -- both low-HP entries (18, 36).
Bowlbug pack.modeled: combat: EnemySim.imbalanced; when this turn's block covers the incoming, each imbalanced attacker's next hit is credited at w_imbalance_stun (0.8/pt) -- the planner now aims for the full block (2026-09-30). Nectar's buff is the generic Buff intent (its Strength shows once applied).
Bowlbug pack.gaps: Fully blocked is judged on total incoming, not per enemy (block is not allocated per attacker in the sim). Nectar's +15 pre-buff kill priority is only implicit (Strength appears after the buff).

Phrog Parasite.mechanic: BOT-OBSERVED from tapes (not an owner decode; consolidated 2026-10-02 from PLAN's early-elite row). Act-1 elite, 61-64 HP, Infested 4: on death it spawns 4 Wrigglers (17-21 HP; alternate a 6->8->10->12 attack with a +2 Str Buff). Every other turn it shuffles 3 Infection status cards into the deck ('Unplayable. At the end of your turn, if this is in your Hand, take 3 damage'); the other turn is a 4x4 multi-hit. A 10-14-card starter deck needs ~5-7 turns on the Phrog, so the Wriggler phase meets a deck that is a third Infections.
Phrog Parasite.modeled: Infested spawn-on-death is modeled (_fight_over keeps the fight alive; plan=sweep in the Wriggler phase). Infection end-of-turn damage rides the stranded-status penalty. Deck-size routing floor exists but is OFF (elite_min_deck_cards=0; PLAN early-elite row).
Phrog Parasite.gaps: Record: A0 era 8 deaths/130 (most at 11-13 cards, floors 7-8); A1 2026-10-01/02 5 deaths, all at 10-14 cards, floors 7-9, 68-82 HP. Tape 34YJS6YHNK (A1, 14 cards): r1 Fiend Fire exhausted Bash/Colossus/2 Strikes for 28 -- burned the deck's best cards on turn 1 of a fight whose enemy keeps seeding Infections (a later Fiend Fire would have exhausted Infections for 7 each). Open question for the owner's act-1 narration: how a human plays this fight with a near-starter deck. PHASE SPLIT (A0+A1 since 09-20, 78 fights): survivors lose 7 HP / 3.2 rounds to the Phrog, then 28 HP / 4.7 rounds to the Wrigglers; deaths lose 15 / 4.6 rounds, then 59 / 5.0 -- the Wriggler phase is the killer, and a slow Phrog kill feeds it (more Infection casts). Wrigglers alternate attack/self-buff (+2 Str each buff: 6->8->10->12).
